title: Spirits of the Elid

overview.startPoint: Talk to Awusah the Mayor in Nardah.
otherReqs: Standard spells equipped or the ability to cast Spellbook Swap

extra.label: League auto-complete
extra.html: Unlocking Desert will auto-complete the quest.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell
items.text: 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell

items.html: A light source (such as a torch, mining helmet, bullseye lantern or Seer's headband)
items.text: A light source (such as a torch, mining helmet, bullseye lantern or Seer's headband)

items.html: One or two spools of thread
items.text: One or two spools of thread

items.html: A weapon for each melee attack style - stab (sword), crush (mace) and slash (scimitar) (other styles work but are extremely inefficient)
items.text: A weapon for each melee attack style - stab (sword), crush (mace) and slash (scimitar) (other styles work but are extremely inefficient)
alternatives: For higher melee levelled players, all may not be needed

items.html: A method of attacking with at least 4 range
items.text: A method of attacking with at least 4 range
alternatives: A Bow or crossbow with ammo unless using chargebow (a shortbow and bronze arrows can be found during the quest)

items.html: Enough coins and a ring of charos for 4 magic carpet rides (300 to 4,000)
items.text: Enough coins and a ring of charos for 4 magic carpet rides (300 to 4,000)

items.html: A traveller's necklace, enchanted broomstick, dominion medallion, ring of slaying, or the Al Kharid lodestone to quickly travel to the source of the River Elid
items.text: A traveller's necklace, enchanted broomstick, dominion medallion, ring of slaying, or the Al Kharid lodestone to quickly travel to the source of the River Elid

items.html: At least 2 drinks from a waterskin—no more are needed if the magic carpets are used
items.text: At least 2 drinks from a waterskin—no more are needed if the magic carpets are used

items.html: Low and medium-level players may bring prayer potions, rings of recoil and/or food to defeat the golems
items.text: Low and medium-level players may bring prayer potions, rings of recoil and/or food to defeat the golems

needed.html: 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell
needed.text: 1 law rune and 1 air rune to cast the Telekinetic Grab spell

blocks.html: Head to Nardah (south of fairy ring DLQ) and talk to Awusah the Mayor in the building east of the fountain.
blocks.text: Head to Nardah (south of fairy ring DLQ) and talk to Awusah the Mayor in the building east of the fountain.

options.text: I am an adventurer in search of quests.
Any idea how you got this curse?

blocks.html: Head to the house north-east of the fountain and talk to Ghaslor the Elder. You should receive a Ballad.
blocks.text: Head to the house north-east of the fountain and talk to Ghaslor the Elder. You should receive a Ballad.

options.text: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.

blocks.html: Head to the building that has a statuette plinth just west of Ghaslor's house and north of the fountain.
blocks.text: Head to the building that has a statuette plinth just west of Ghaslor's house and north of the fountain.

blocks.html: Telegrab the ancestral key from the table.
blocks.text: Telegrab the ancestral key from the table.

substeps.html: You may attach the ancestral key to your steel key ring if you've completed the One Small Favour quest
substeps.text: You may attach the ancestral key to your steel key ring if you've completed the One Small Favour quest

blocks.html: Go to the other side of the building and open the northernmost cupboard and search it for the robe top and bottom.
blocks.text: Go to the other side of the building and open the northernmost cupboard and search it for the robe top and bottom.

blocks.html: Fix the top and bottom robes.
blocks.text: Fix the top and bottom robes.

needed.html: A weapon and ammo for a combat type other than melee
needed.text: A weapon and ammo for a combat type other than melee

blocks.html: Head north, past the Dominion Tower until a waterfall is seen.
blocks.text: Head north, past the Dominion Tower until a waterfall is seen.

substeps.html: You can teleport to there by using a traveller's necklace to south of the Uzer eagles' eyrie.
substeps.text: You can teleport to there by using a traveller's necklace to south of the Uzer eagles' eyrie.

substeps.html: There is a bronze arrow south-east of Dominion Tower and a shortbow north-east of it.
substeps.text: There is a bronze arrow south-east of Dominion Tower and a shortbow north-east of it.

blocks.html: Climb the waterfall.
blocks.text: Climb the waterfall.

blocks.html: Equip the Robes of Elidinis and open the door.
blocks.text: Equip the Robes of Elidinis and open the door.

substeps.html: If the door will not open, make sure you repaired and are wearing both robe pieces, and make sure you have the Ancestral key you tele-grabbed earlier.
substeps.text: If the door will not open, make sure you repaired and are wearing both robe pieces, and make sure you have the Ancestral key you tele-grabbed earlier.

blocks.html: Head east to the three doors.
blocks.text: Head east to the three doors.

blocks.html: Try to open any door, kill the golem that spawns, then enter the room and clear the water channel for each room.
blocks.text: Try to open any door, kill the golem that spawns, then enter the room and clear the water channel for each room.

substeps.html: If you click the door before the golem's death animation has finished, it will respawn and you will have to fight it again.
substeps.text: If you click the door before the golem's death animation has finished, it will respawn and you will have to fight it again.

Head through the door to the north and talk to one of the spirits in the large area.
blocks.text: Head through the door to the north and talk to one of the spirits in the large area.

options.text: I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah.
Is there anything they can do to get their fountain working again?

blocks.html: Head back to Nardah.
blocks.text: Head back to Nardah.

substeps.html: It is possible to be bugged when exiting the cave. To get out of the bug, simply use a Home Teleport spell.
substeps.text: It is possible to be bugged when exiting the cave. To get out of the bug, simply use a Home Teleport spell.

substeps.html: Amulet of glory teleport to Al Kharid and then taking the magic carpet to Nardah is a quick option.
substeps.text: Amulet of glory teleport to Al Kharid and then taking the magic carpet to Nardah is a quick option.

blocks.html: Talk to Awusah the Mayor.
blocks.text: Talk to Awusah the Mayor.

blocks.html: Take shoes just south from the entrance door inside the Mayor's house.
blocks.text: Take shoes just south from the entrance door inside the Mayor's house.

blocks.html: Go outside the house, then remove-sole from the shoes to obtain a sole.
blocks.text: Go outside the house, then remove-sole from the shoes to obtain a sole.

substeps.html: Ensure you have a light source or you will not be able to talk to the next NPC without being interrupted.
substeps.text: Ensure you have a light source or you will not be able to talk to the next NPC without being interrupted.

blocks.html: Head west from the Nardah General Store, past a camp of trainee adventurers and climb-down the crevice.
blocks.text: Head west from the Nardah General Store, past a camp of trainee adventurers and climb-down the crevice.

blocks.html: Talk to the Genie, then talk again.
blocks.text: Talk to the Genie, then talk again.

options.text: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Maybe I can make a deal for it?
Ok I agree to the deal.

substeps.html: If your backpack was full, pick up the Statuette. - There will be room now as you gave the Genie a sole.
substeps.text: If your backpack was full, pick up the Statuette. - There will be room now as you gave the Genie a sole.

blocks.html: Head back to Nardah and use the statuette on the plinth in the shrine room, north of the fountain.
blocks.text: Head back to Nardah and use the statuette on the plinth in the shrine room, north of the fountain.

substeps.html: Optional: Pray at the statue for medium desert task achievement Heathen Idle.
substeps.text: Optional: Pray at the statue for medium desert task achievement Heathen Idle.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

items.html: Access to Nardah's fountain and shrine (praying at the statue will fill your life points, temporarily boost it, and restore your prayer points)
items.text: Access to Nardah's fountain and shrine (praying at the statue will fill your life points, temporarily boost it, and restore your prayer points)
